isolation: Owned temporary PostgreSQL clusters/databases and server processes; inherited application settings cleared for outbox and paired socket comparison.
capacity_http_protocol: Loopback TCP; real cookie jars, CSRF, password verification and business responses; fsync/full_page_writes/synchronous_commit enabled.

paired_protocol.dataset: medium seed, 120 threads and 1800 posts plus benchmark accounts

diagnostic_protocol: 150 PostgreSQL integration files, jobs=2, followed by one HTTP subprocess supplement, jobs=1. Trace records exclude request bodies, SQL arguments and exception messages.
raw_file_policy: Copied JSON/JSONL are byte-identical to producer outputs. Request/SQL trace streams and process logs remain local; normalized TAP summaries are included.
